sampling.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q3305213; p:P127 ?s. ?s ps:P127 ?owner. FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s pq:P582 ?end } ?s prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref. } LIMIT 70
sampling.selection: First 16 distinct fetched painting items with a nondeprecated P127 value, references, and no end-time qualifier; preferred rank chosen first. Endpoint ordering is not a probability sample.

limitations: No claim of 16 independent source/template clusters.
No current ownership claim: prose is explicitly source-record-scoped.
KO labels fall back to original EN proper name when no KO label exists.
CC0 applies to structured data; external reference page text is not republished.
No R answer prompts, test data, OOD data, or model observations.

audit.source_fact_fidelity: Exact Wikidata statements retained; upstream pages not independently reverified. Some references may be imports or authority catalogue IDs, and historical ownership statements may have incomplete time qualifiers.
